Before you come

What are your opening hours?

We are open every day of the week, Monday to Sunday, from 11 AM to 9 PM.

Do I need to reserve?

The restaurant has about 6 tables, so we suggest calling ahead on 092 445 6958.

Where exactly are you?

On the third floor at 686, 688 บางโพงพาง, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120. Search the Plus Code MGHH+V6 in Google Maps.

Is it easy to reach on foot?

The dining room is up three floors of stairs. A guest noted this may be hard for older guests who can't climb stairs, so please call if you need advice.

Can I get food to go?

Yes. We offer kerbside pickup and no-contact delivery as well as dine-in.

How much does a meal cost?

Guests report spending about ฿400–600 per person.
